tokens.name: white
tokens.usage: Page ground, about 70 % of every page. Black logo and `ink` text sit on it.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Title, lead and body text on `white` and light tints; the black of cut walls and the logo; about 14 % of a page. Contrast on white 18:1.

tokens.name: grey-700
tokens.usage: Subtitle on `white`. Contrast 6.7:1.

tokens.name: grey-500
tokens.usage: Comments, links, footers, captions and labels on `white`. Source value kept exact: contrast on white is 3.5:1, below 4.5:1 for 8.5 pt text, so keep these lines short and never set body text in it.

tokens.name: grey-050
tokens.usage: Quiet panel and table ground under `ink` text.

tokens.name: red
tokens.usage: KOKO red, about 1 % of a page. At most once per page: one thin full-height column or rule, or the one word or number to find first. Never a fill, block, heading or background; diagrams use the scheme accent instead.

tokens.name: rose-guide
tokens.usage: Draft column guides only, never in a final page.

tokens.name: site-green
tokens.usage: Site outside the building in schemes and plans, one soft green.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: 30 pt. Title states the point of the page; `ink`. Starts two logo heights below the top margin.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: 11 pt everywhere, screen decks too; `ink`; columns of 45 to 60 characters.

styles.name: comment
styles.usage: 8.5 pt for comments, links, footers and captions; `grey-500`.

styles.name: key-figure
styles.usage: 40 pt Inter Semibold, `ink`: one number to find first.

tokens.name: margin-slide
tokens.usage: Page margin on the 1920 px master (12.7 mm); also the logo's distance from top and right.

tokens.name: gutter-slide
tokens.usage: Gutter between the 12 columns (6.3 mm); half a margin.

tokens.name: column-slide
tokens.usage: One grid column (20.3 mm). A text column is 4 grid columns.

tokens.name: logo-height
tokens.usage: KOKO logo height on the 1920 px master (6.1 mm). Clear space around the logo equals one logo height; the title starts two logo heights below the top margin.
